subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should the production-wide gateway admission change remain bundled with this Matrix QA migration, or land first as a separately reviewed prerequisite?
rationale: The change is plausibly correct and now directly tested, but it alters channel restart lifecycle behavior across all transports while this PR otherwise presents itself as a QA-only refactor.

options.title: Split the gateway prerequisite
options.body: Land the generic process-lifetime channel-start admission fix separately, then rebase this Matrix migration onto that reviewed behavior.

options.title: Accept the combined landing
options.body: Keep the change bundled after explicit QA/Gateway owner signoff, exact-head dependency authorization, and completed current-head checks.

recommendation.title: Split the gateway prerequisite
recommendation.body: Land the generic process-lifetime channel-start admission fix separately, then rebase this Matrix migration onto that reviewed behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current Matrix QA stack and authored the merged predecessor, making them the clearest coordinator for a split or combined landing decision.
